title: Traffic Cone Dropper & Retriever
summary: A group design project (SEMM1513): an Arduino prototype that places and collects traffic cones automatically, so road workers don’t have to. My concept was chosen as the final design.

cover.caption: Illustration of the prototype: cones on the conveyor, the stopper gate and a placed cone

specs.v: Concept 2: selected as the final design

milestones.text: Problem statement and research on existing cone trucks
Product design specification (PDS) for a full-scale system
Morphological charts for mechanisms and control system
Five concepts, one per team member
Final concept refined: stopper mechanism, plastic wheels, AA pack
SolidWorks models: conveyor base and stopper

log.text: Final report submitted. In testing, the prototype placed and retrieved traffic cones effectively. 🎉
